annotation.title_en: Platform Project for Development, Demonstration and Dissemination of Nursing-Care Robots (MHLW care robot portal)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 厚生労働省 (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare)
annotation.venue: 厚生労働省ウェブサイト
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MHLW portal page on nursing-care robots, indexing project reports, development and adoption support, subsidies, tax and financing measures, and safety standards (ISO 13482, JIS B8445/B8446). It is a policy-promotion index focused on development, demonstration and diffusion of care robots to improve productivity.
key_provisions_or_claims: MHLW and METI define priority fields (6 areas, 13 items) for robot technology in nursing care
Platform for development, demonstration and dissemination with needs-seeds matching support
Subsidies (AMED, NEDO, regional medical-care fund) up to 300k yen per device, 1M yen for transfer/bathing robots
Tax measures and financing support for care robot and ICT adoption
Safety standards listed: ISO 13482 and JIS B8445, B8446 series, JIS Y1001
